article.story: NEWARK, N.J. -- — Declan Wucherpfennig had 14 points in Fairfield's 74-53 victory over NJIT on Saturday. Wucherpfennig also had eight rebounds for the Stags (1-1). Braden Sparks scored 14 points while going 3 of 9 from the floor, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range. Tony Williams went 5 of 7 from the field (3 for 4 from 3-point range) to finish with 13 points. The Highlanders (1-1) were led in scoring by David Bolden, who finished with 12 points, six rebounds and four steals. NJIT also got eight points and two blocks from Ari Fulton. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
